what: Numerous Bengali Gosains at Goyeshbari with followers among Poli and North Bengal castes; Baisnabi doctrines; Goswami family of Goyeshpur descended from Nityananda. Vaishnava Gosains, not Dasnami.
quote: there are numerous Bengali Gosains living at Goyeshbari who have numbers of followers amongst the Poli-and Nerth Bengal castes.

what: Colony of celibate Brahmins (Thakuranjis) who regard themselves as gopis and worship Krishna in women's clothes; Tulsi Bihar mela. Vaishnava.
quote: At Jangaltola on the left bank of the Bhagirathi and some 7 miles south-west of English Bisar is a colony of Brahmins: known a8 Thakuranjis, who observe celibacy.
